name: Scrubness — SEO and website optimisation
summary: Optimising the Scrubness WooCommerce store (scrubness.com) for search: product updates, site clean-up, page speed, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics (GA4, Google Tag Manager and Meta pixel).
description: Scrubness is a scrubs brand (scrub tops and scrub pants for women and men) sold online at scrubness.com, a WordPress and WooCommerce store, and also stocked by Southern Uniforms. The work covers updating the products, cleaning up and speeding up the website, SEO and GEO content for every product, and analytics.
businessObjective: Update the products and optimise scrubness.com for search engines and AI answer engines (SEO and GEO): clean up the site, improve page speed, write SEO content for each product using the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush, and set up analytics with GA4, Google Tag Manager and the Meta pixel.
background: scrubness.com runs on WordPress and WooCommerce behind Cloudflare, with Yoast SEO, Autoptimize and W3 Total Cache active (checked 16 Nov 2026). There was no GA4, Google Tag Manager or Meta pixel on the site at that check. Keyword research and SEO content will use the free tiers of Ahrefs and Semrush. scrubness.com is one of the websites checked by Site Monitor.
responsibilitySummary: Product updates, SEO and GEO, page speed and analytics
responsibilities: Product data and product page updates
Website clean-up and technical SEO (URLs, categories, sitemap, indexing)
SEO and GEO content for each product
Testing changes on a local copy before they go live
progressSummary: Site restored after the 9–10 Nov outage; Home mobile PageSpeed 69 → 95 and Shop 76 → 79; 2026 catalogue, SKUs, barcodes and descriptions live; homepage, footer and contact page refreshed; site clean-up, SEO basics and product-photo alt text done. Next: SEO tool trial, titles, meta descriptions and SEO/GEO content, and analytics.
sourceNote: Status from Mahesh's work records of 6–16 Nov 2026, with changes checked on the live site (several re-checked on 16 Nov 2026).

tasks.title: Full website backup
tasks.description: Took a complete backup of the Scrubness WordPress site (files and database) with an installer, so the site can be restored or moved if needed.
tasks.evidence: Backup archive and installer dated 6 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Live catalogue export
tasks.description: Exported the live catalogue (84 products, 842 size variants) to prepare the 2026 product updates.
tasks.evidence: WooCommerce product export dated 10 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Business and marketing strategy document
tasks.description: Prepared a business and marketing strategy for Scrubness covering the business model, platform, customers, resources, current costs, recommended investments, an initial digital marketing plan and a growth roadmap. Recommendations in it are proposals for management review.
tasks.evidence: Strategy document attached under Resources (16 Nov 2026).

tasks.title: SKUs and barcodes on the 2026 catalogue
tasks.description: Confirmed the 2026 catalogue as 22 colour products and imported SKUs and barcodes (308 rows, tested on a local copy first). 64 products not in the 2026 catalogue hidden.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site via the public store data, 11 Nov.

tasks.title: Product descriptions and sizes
tasks.description: Description import for 15 products with "Behind the design" and "Features" sections (new copy for Ellen and Charlie from the 2026 catalogue); Joggeroo sizes set to XS–3XL.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, 11 Nov.

tasks.title: Home page mobile speed: PageSpeed 69 → 95
tasks.description: Mobile PageSpeed 69 → 95, first paint 3.1 s → 1.2 s, main image (LCP) 7.4 s → 2.9 s, Speed Index 5.6 s → 2.8 s, with the design unchanged on phone and desktop. JavaScript "defer" and W3 Total Cache manual minify were tested or assessed and not adopted (no gain, risk to cart and checkout).
tasks.evidence: PageSpeed Insights before and after, 10 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Empty blocks and placeholder text removed
tasks.description: Unnecessary empty editor blocks removed, one of two empty rows under the Home hero removed, and the "(state address)" placeholder on the FAQ replaced with the real return address. Breadcrumbs hidden on normal pages.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site.

tasks.title: Contact page
tasks.description: New /contact/ page with an enquiry form (name, email, phone, enquiry type, message), phone, address, email and hours; linked from the footer and included in the sitemap.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, 12 Nov; sitemap re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: New footer
tasks.description: Four columns (Shop, Help, Contact, Follow) and a credits bar with Terms of Use and Privacy Policy. Links to two private pages removed; all 12 footer links open.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site at 1440, 768 and 390 px.

tasks.title: Categories and tags restructured
tasks.description: Categories renamed with flat URLs (mens-scrub-tops, womens-scrub-tops, scrub-pants) and intro text; old Men/Women parent categories removed; tags reduced to Men and Women; Best Sellers fixed.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, 11 Nov.

tasks.title: Junk pages and test products removed from public view
tasks.description: Junk pages set to private; $1 "Offer" and "Credit" products return 404; a broken reseller registration page hidden; Cart, Checkout, My Account and All Colours set to noindex (they still work); three "-copy" product URLs renamed with permanent redirects.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site (13 Nov), re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: Sitemap and robots.txt fixed
tasks.description: The page sitemap went from 29 entries to the 8 real pages; the product sitemap lists only the 22 catalogue products; robots.txt now points to https://scrubness.com/sitemap.xml.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: Keyword research with a 7-day Ahrefs or Semrush trial
tasks.description: Starts once the open items above are done. The crawler needs JavaScript rendering and a low crawl speed because of the site's bot check.

tasks.title: SEO and GEO content: titles, meta descriptions and product copy
tasks.description: Write page titles and meta descriptions (missing on Shop, categories, all 22 products and several information pages) and product copy from the keyword data, so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite the products.
tasks.dependency: Keyword data from the SEO tool trial.

tasks.title: Analytics set-up
tasks.description: No Google Analytics, Tag Manager or Search Console tag is on the site (checked 16 Nov). Set up the chosen analytics, Tag Manager and Meta pixel.
tasks.dependency: Decision on which analytics to install.

tasks.title: Page-speed baseline
tasks.description: Measured mobile performance before any change: score about 69–70, first paint 3.1 s, main image (LCP) 7.4 s, Speed Index 5.6 s. The homepage hero image was the main delay.
tasks.evidence: PageSpeed Insights runs, 9–10 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Hero image preloaded
tasks.description: The browser fetches the hero image first, for both phone and desktop versions.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: Separate phone hero image
tasks.description: Phones load a 45 KB hero image instead of the 117 KB desktop image; each device downloads only its own image.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site (phones download only the small image).

tasks.title: Smaller hover photos on Home, Shop and categories
tasks.description: Product hover photos load the 768 px version instead of the 1280 px original, saving about 100 KB per photo (24 photos on Home).
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site.

tasks.title: Critical CSS
tasks.description: CSS optimisation moved from W3 Total Cache to Autoptimize with critical CSS, so no stylesheet holds up the first view. Design compared before and after on phone and desktop: unchanged.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site.

tasks.title: Last empty row under the Home hero removed
tasks.description: Closes the remaining gap of about 50 px on phones.
tasks.evidence: Confirmed by Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Hosting fixed after the 9–10 Nov outage
tasks.description: PHP upgraded to 8.3 (required by Contact Form 7), PHP memory raised from 128 MB to 512 MB and disk space freed. The site has loaded normally since 10 Nov.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site since 10 Nov.

tasks.title: Page and browser caching
tasks.description: W3 Total Cache page cache and browser cache turned on (server response about 150 ms); theme page transitions turned off.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site.

tasks.title: Local fonts and fewer blocking files
tasks.description: Google Fonts served from the site itself instead of Google, and the WordPress icon font no longer loaded for visitors.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site.

tasks.title: About Us banner optimised
tasks.description: The 1.6 MB PNG banner was replaced with a 72 KB WebP, plus a 30 KB phone version with preload. Main image (LCP) on phones went from 11.6 s to 5.3 s before the phone version was added.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: Shop page speed: PageSpeed 76 → 79
tasks.description: Shop and category pages now load correctly sized images (phone image download 412 KB → 234 KB), show the first 4 product pictures straight away and preload the first 2. Mobile score 76 → 79, LCP 5.9 s → 5.6 s. The score of 79 is accepted for now.
tasks.evidence: PageSpeed runs from 13 Nov 2026 onward.

tasks.title: Image optimisation and WebP
tasks.description: Bulk image optimisation with Smush; WebP versions served to browsers that support them (one product image 7.8 KB WebP vs 15.9 KB JPG). Shop and category thumbnails raised from 300 px to 600 px so they are sharp.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site (WebP 11 Nov, thumbnails 13 Nov).

tasks.title: Homepage refreshed for the 2026 range
tasks.description: Same style with updated content: 2026 colours strip, Women's / Men's / Pants tiles, best-seller rows (a swipe slider on phones), phone layout fixes, a re-cropped pink banner and a new Ellen, Charlie and Joey banner. Approved 11 Nov.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site at desktop, tablet and phone, 12 Nov.

tasks.title: Sitemap baseline audit
tasks.description: Checked every sitemap URL (all loaded, no 404s) and listed junk pages, test products, empty pages, placeholder text and typos for clean-up.
tasks.evidence: Sitemap baseline report, 10 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Shop and product page improvements
tasks.description: Size buttons instead of a dropdown (out-of-stock sizes disabled), a desktop gallery with thumbnails, a "Shop All Scrubs" heading and intro, phone layout fixes, and all shop and product styling consolidated into one code snippet.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, 12–13 Nov.

tasks.title: Full SEO check of all 33 public pages
tasks.description: Status codes, redirects, canonicals, titles, headings, schema, sitemap, internal links and mixed content checked before starting the SEO tool trial.
tasks.evidence: Pre-trial check report, 13 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: SEO fixes: titles, schema, share images, headings
tasks.description: Category titles no longer end in "Archives"; Organization schema added; social share image set; one H1 on every product page and on About Us (Home reduced from 3 to 2, kept for the animation).
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site (13 Nov), re-checked 16 Nov.

tasks.title: Alt text on all 88 product photos
tasks.description: Descriptive alt text on every product photo (22 products × 4), including fixes for 6 errors found on 13 Nov.
tasks.evidence: Verified on the live site, 16 Nov (88 of 88).

tasks.title: Next Shop page speed step
tasks.description: Target the slowest part of the Shop page's main-image load; a score in the 80s is expected to be realistic with 12 product pictures.
tasks.dependency: PageSpeed "LCP breakdown" timings from the Shop page.

tasks.title: Re-measure Home, About Us and product page speed
tasks.description: Re-run Home after the homepage refresh (regenerate critical CSS if needed), report About Us after the phone banner, and measure product pages for the first time.

tasks.title: Cloudflare speed and bot-check settings
tasks.description: The site runs behind Cloudflare.

tasks.title: Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools
tasks.description: Set up both, submit the sitemap, request a recrawl and check for pages dropped during the outage.

tasks.title: Confirm the test enquiry arrived
tasks.description: A test enquiry was sent from the live contact form on 12 Nov and the site reported it as sent; delivery to hello@scrubness.com (or spam) is not yet confirmed.

tasks.title: Full test order and real-phone testing
tasks.description: Each size, payment, customer and store emails, order status and an out-of-stock size; then size buttons, gallery, size chart, menu and checkout on an iPhone and an Android phone.

tasks.title: Content fixes
tasks.description: Category intros no longer mention prints, the Vegemite tag is removed, and "& JOEY" is bold in the Ellen, Charlie and Joey banner.
tasks.evidence: Confirmed by Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026; category intros and the tag removal checked on the live site on 16 Nov 2026.

tasks.title: Permanent redirect from scrubness.com.au
tasks.description: scrubness.com.au redirects to scrubness.com with a temporary (302) redirect; it should be permanent (301).

tasks.title: Fresh product export to confirm SKUs and barcodes
tasks.description: Double-check every SKU and barcode after the 11 Nov import.

tasks.title: Image alt text fix: Home and About Us
tasks.description: Six images still have no alt text on the live site (checked 16 Nov 2026): three icons on Home and three images on About Us.

tasks.title: Security hardening
tasks.description: Add a security plugin and close publicly exposed WordPress information, scheduled after the SEO work.

tasks.title: Decide on the About Us layout mock-up
tasks.description: A tighter About Us layout with a "Find your fit" block linking to the three categories is ready for review.

issues.title: GST display on shop prices
issues.description: How GST is shown on shop prices has been resolved (Confirmed by Mahesh on 16 Nov 2026).

issues.title: Which analytics to install
issues.description: No Google Analytics, Tag Manager or Search Console verification is on the site. A decision is needed on which analytics to install and who owns the accounts.

issues.title: Site outage, 9–10 Nov
issues.description: The site was unavailable. Causes found: hosting disk full, PHP older than 8.3 (required by Contact Form 7) and PHP memory at 128 MB. Fixed on 10 Nov by upgrading PHP, raising memory and freeing disk space. Checking for pages dropped from Google waits on Search Console access.

issues.title: Cloudflare account owner
issues.description: Needed for Cloudflare speed and bot-check settings.

issues.title: Backup schedule
issues.description: No safe server-side backup is in place on the current hosting. A backup approach needs to be agreed.

issues.title: Size chart errors
issues.description: The pants size chart (on all 8 pants products) has two columns labelled 3XL, and Joggeroo's chart lists 4XL and 5XL although it is sold up to 3XL.
